title: PNPShift: an NMR chemical shift predictor for purine-nucleotide-bound and unliganded proteins.
authors: Zeng, Mingfei; Liu, Dan; Shui, Leilei; Wang, Hao; Long, Dong
one_liner_zh: PNPShift是一个基于人工神经网络的NMR化学位移预测器，专门提升嘌呤核苷酸结合蛋白的化学位移预测精度，并用于结构系综精修和构象判别，属于蛋白质结构计算建模中的AI方法。
abstract: Accurate prediction of protein chemical shifts is important for NMR-based structural and ensemble modeling. However, most existing predictors are designed for unliganded proteins and cannot quantitatively calculate the chemical shifts of purine nucleotide-bound proteins, which are encoded by approximately 10% of the human genome and play critical roles in signal transduction, energy metabolism, and other cellular processes. Here, we introduce PNPShift, an artificial neural network-based program designed to improve chemical shift prediction accuracy for purine nucleotide-bound proteins. By incorporating the PNPShift-X(PN) correction, PNPShift reduces (1)H(N) prediction errors in nucleotide-binding regions by up to ~ 30% across 28 tested purine nucleotide-bound proteins. PNPShift also improves (1)H(N) predictions for unliganded proteins, achieving a ~ 6% reduction in RMSE across an independent test set of 60 proteins. The utility of PNPShift in structural and dynamics modeling is demonstrated by its superior performance in maximum-entropy (MEM)-based ensemble refinement and its greater ability to discriminate native states from decoy conformations compared with other leading programs. PNPShift not only extends accurate chemical-shift prediction to purine nucleotide-bound proteins critical for diverse cellular functions, but also illustrates a general framework for developing predictors for other liganded protein systems.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质化学位移的准确预测对于基于核磁共振的结构和系综建模至关重要。然而，现有的大多数预测器是为未结合配体的蛋白质设计的，无法定量计算嘌呤核苷酸结合蛋白的化学位移，这类蛋白质由人类基因组中约10%的基因编码，在信号转导、能量代谢及其他细胞过程中发挥关键作用。在此，我们介绍PNPShift，一种基于人工神经网络的程序，旨在提高嘌呤核苷酸结合蛋白的化学位移预测准确性。通过整合PNPShift-X(PN)校正，PNPShift在28个测试的嘌呤核苷酸结合蛋白中，将核苷酸结合区域的(1)H(N)预测误差最多降低约30%。PNPShift还改善了未结合配体蛋白的(1)H(N)预测，在包含60个蛋白质的独立测试集上，均方根误差（RMSE）降低约6%。PNPShift在结构和动力学建模中的实用性，通过其在基于最大熵（MEM）的系综精修中的优越性能，以及与其他领先程序相比，在区分天然态与诱饵构象方面的更强能力得到证明。PNPShift不仅将准确的化学位移预测扩展到对多种细胞功能至关重要的嘌呤核苷酸结合蛋白，而且为开发其他配体结合蛋白系统的预测器提供了一个通用框架。
